n = int(input())
B = int(input())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))

c0, c1 = 0, 0
import heapq
q = []

for i in range(n):
    if a[i] % 2 == 0:
        c0 += 1
    else:
        c1 += 1

    if c0 == c1 and i < n - 1:
        heapq.heappush(q, abs(a[i + 1] - a[i]))

cnt = 0
sum_q = 0
while q and sum_q + q[0] <= B:
    sum_q += heapq.heappop(q)
    cnt += 1

print(cnt)
